title: Plato took ergot at Eleusis

tellings.quote: he went to Elusis and he was tripping on Urgot

plain: Plato went to Eleusis, the ancient Greek site of secret initiation rites, and was tripping on ergot, a fungus that grows on grain and can cause hallucinations. Michels says this himself in an episode with the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore, linking it to Plato's Republic without naming any other source. If true, one of the founders of Western philosophy would have drawn on a psychedelic experience.
